item.title: Corporate Supply Chain Risks in Emerging Markets: Assessment, Management, and Impact
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines supply chain risks faced by corporations operating in emerging markets. The focus is on understanding how companies can assess, manage, and respond to the various challenges and disruptions that arise from supply chain operations in these regions, as well as the broader consequences these risks have for organizational performance and competitiveness.

Appel publié par Emerging Markets Review. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Supply chain risk assessment in emerging markets
  • Supply chain risk management strategies
  • Impact of supply chain disruptions on corporate performance
  • Emerging market specific supply chain vulnerabilities
  • Risk mitigation and resilience building in supply chains
